title: Medusastraße, Kiel
description: Discover a comfortable and inviting 3-room apartment in the heart of Kiel, perfect for up to 4 guests. Spread across 75 square meters, this top-floor retreat offers a blend of practicality and relaxation. Each guest can enjoy the privacy of their own with two single bed, and one queen size bed making it ideal for families or groups of friends. The apartment is well-equipped with modern amenities to enhance your stay. The kitchen comes complete with all necessary cooking supplies, ensuring you have everything needed to prepare meals with ease. After a day of exploring, unwind in the cozy living area with a comfortable sofa and TV. Additional features include a shared shower and access to a washing machine for a touch of luxury. Cleaning supplies are provided for your convenience. Experience a balance of comfort and affordability in this well-appointed apartment, designed to make your stay in Kiel as enjoyable as possible.

 Separate Küche mit allem, was man braucht – inkl. Essplatz für zwei
